  1. Worth the detour · Chinese, Dim Sum & Teochew · Ipoh

    Lou Wong Bean Sprout Chicken

    Ipoh's iconic tauge ayam since 1957 — poached chicken, blanched bean sprouts and smooth hor fun. Anthony Bourdain ate here; still open, moving to a bigger site in 2026.

    Jalan Yau Tet Shin, Ipoh, Perak, Malaysia (relocating to a larger nearby space in 2026)
